resumeText:
Karan Malhotra
Gurugram, Haryana | karan.malhotra@example.com

Executive - Compensation & Benefits, Northfield Pharma Ltd, Gurugram (Jun 2023 - Present)
- Ran salary benchmarking for 300 sales and plant roles against two external market surveys
- Revised pay bands for field sales grades and tracked compa-ratio by grade each quarter
- Supported the annual increment cycle and did the bonus calculation for 2,400 employees
- Managed the group mediclaim renewal and GPA and GTL policies with the insurance broker
- Modelled increment budgets in Excel using pivot tables and XLOOKUP for the CHRO
- Updated revised salaries and grades in the Darwinbox HRMS after each increment cycle
- Checked gratuity and statutory bonus payouts against the Payment of Gratuity Act and the Payment of Bonus Act
- Worked through cross-functional collaboration with finance and HRBPs on budget sign-off

HR Analyst, Meridian Retail Pvt Ltd, Noida (Jul 2022 - May 2023)
- Built attrition dashboards and monthly HR MIS reporting for store leadership

Education: MBA (HR), BBA.
